changes.evidence: S2#16 (Afterlife): Jiaying offers to be Skye's guide 'though she does not reveal that she is Skye's mother'. S2#17 (Melinda): Jiaying reveals she is Skye's mother. S2#22 (S.O.S. Part Two): she drains Skye's life force until Cal kills her.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#10
now.text: Daniel Whitehall wants Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, brought to him, since decades earlier he cut open her mother, Jiaying, to steal her youth. Coulson kills him when the team storms his base to get Skye back.
now.on_a_card_about_b: The HYDRA leader who cut open Daisy's mother and wants Daisy brought to him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Daughter of Jiaying, the woman Whitehall cut open. He wants her brought to him.

proposed.text: Daniel Whitehall wants Daisy Johnson, then known as Skye, brought to him, since decades earlier he cut open her mother to steal her youth. Coulson kills him when the team storms his base to get Skye back.

changes.evidence: In S2#10 (What They Become) Cal only tells Skye that Whitehall killed her mother; naming her mother as Jiaying is the S2#17 (Melinda) reveal, and in S2#16 Jiaying hides it.

changes.evidence: S2#14 (Love in the Time of Hydra): Weaver calculates Hunter needs 12 hours to reach land and Morse says she can take Coulson's base in 6. Following Fitz and pressing May about Theta Protocol happen after May joins the council (S2#16, per the fandom Anne Weaver page, ref AoS216); Theta Protocol is not mentioned in S2#14.
